input.summary: Lock one ball in either saucer. Pop-bumper and slingshot hits toggle Release; when Release is lit, shoot the spinner to start two-ball Multiball. During Multiball, keep both balls in play and shoot either saucer to relock one ball.

quickInfo.name: Lock and Release
quickInfo.summary: Either saucer locks one ball. Pop-bumper and slingshot hits toggle Release; when Release is lit, the spinner releases the held ball for two-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: R-O-C-K
quickInfo.summary: Complete the R-O-C-K rollovers to light Extra Ball. Any R-O-C-K or return rollover starts the Display Feature Award sequence.

quickInfo.name: CLUB and RIO
quickInfo.summary: Complete either CLUB or RIO target-bank sequence to advance the NIGHT MOVES bonus toward Special.

quickInfo.name: Right flipper
quickInfo.summary: The right flipper rotates the lit Extra Ball and R-O-C-K lamps and freezes the top LITE 2X lamp.

steps.text: Shoot either saucer to lock one ball.
modeNotes: The ball remains in that saucer while the next ball enters play.

steps.text: After the lock, hit pop bumpers or slingshots until Release is lit.
modeNotes: These switches toggle Release. Read the lamp before shooting the spinner.

steps.text: When Release is lit, shoot the spinner to release the locked ball and start two-ball Multiball.
modeNotes: The spinner is the Multiball start only while Release is lit.

steps.text: During Multiball, keep both balls in play and shoot either saucer to relock one ball.
modeNotes: Relocking one ball leaves the other ball live and returns the game to the Release sequence.

steps.text: Hit pop bumpers or slingshots until Release is lit again, then shoot the spinner to return to two-ball play. Repeat the relock-and-release loop while both balls remain available.
Complete either the CLUB target-bank sequence or the RIO target-bank sequence to advance the NIGHT MOVES bonus.
Repeat those target-bank completions until the NIGHT MOVES bonus sequence is complete and Special lights.

checkBeforePlay: Test both saucers, the Release lamp, spinner, R-O-C-K rollovers, and right-flipper lamp rotation.
input.simpleOverview: Night Moves turns one locked ball into a repeatable release loop. Lock at either saucer, use pop-bumper and slingshot hits to light Release, then shoot the spinner for two-ball play. Relock a ball during Multiball and repeat the same Release sequence.
input.overview: Night Moves turns either saucer lock into a repeatable two-ball scoring loop. Pop-bumper and slingshot hits toggle Release; when Release is lit, the spinner releases the locked ball. Relock and repeat while two balls remain, then use single-ball play for R-O-C-K awards and CLUB or RIO completions toward the NIGHT MOVES Special.
